review.note: Reviewed all 11 Python and 1 Node direct requirement entries, including registry candidates outside declared bounds. The only changed direct candidate since the previous reviewed receipt is h2hdb 0.38.3; all external candidates and their prior release-note reviews are unchanged and support Python 3.14. Reviewed the local upstream core release history from 0.37.3 through 0.38.3 and the 0.39.0 schema-7 implementation: the injected public queue facade remains intact, while schema admission now requires epoch 3/version 7. Require h2hdb>=0.39.0,<0.40.0 instead of keeping older schema-6 lanes or a runtime compatibility shim. Registry core 0.38.3 is intentionally below this coordinated unreleased candidate; validation used the explicitly supplied h2hdb 0.39.0 wheel SHA-256 b3756eb80768c60ae44290b92ad8deefde15a4311397f31eefb300e3e543fb0c. Installed that wheel and editable downloader[dev] together through the complete upgrading resolver, verified wheel/editable origins, and uv pip check accepted all 43 installed packages. The resolver also refreshed transitive ast-serialize to 0.11.2 and wrapt to 2.4.1. All 161 offline tests passed with actual core 0.39.0, including real SQLite queue/turn coordination and dependency-regression rejection of the previous upper bound. Ruff, formatter, strict mypy and Markdown checks passed. The downloader library keeps injected facade ownership and has no new startup, schema migration, browser/network, or archive behavior. Core provides and independently validates the one-time offline schema-6-to-7 conversion preserving database facts and CBZ files. Final exact integration runs the repository check-full merge hook, including the sdist/wheel build and isolated installed-runtime-requirements/public-export check; that gate result is reported separately. No live account or network runtime is exercised.
